qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M6 camshaft bearing cap screws?
What torque should be applied to M10 sprocket to camshaft screws on M20/M21/M40 engines?
What is the difference in torque between M6 and M8 camshaft bearing cap screws?
qa_pairs.answer: M6 screws require 10 Nm while M8 screws require 20 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What are the two torque specifications required for sprocket to camshaft installation on M51/M41 engines?
qa_pairs.answer: 20 Nm torque followed by 35° torque angle

qa_pairs.question: What thread specification is used for splined shaft to intake camshaft on M52/S52/S50 US/M50 VANOS engines?
What torque value applies to M7 screws for sprocket to camshaft flange on all engines except M50/M52/S52/S50 US/M50 VANOS?
What is the initial torque specification for splined shaft to intake camshaft before applying the torque angle?
Which camshaft component uses the highest torque specification shown on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: Sprocket to camshaft on M20/M21/M40 engines at 65 Nm
